# Yonatan Bisk / CLAW @ CMU

> Connecting Language to Action and the World -- Yonatan Bisk's lab at Carnegie Mellon University, working on embodied AI, grounded language, robotics, and multimodal machine learning.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://talkingtorobots.com/): About the CLAW lab and its research themes.
- [Publications](https://talkingtorobots.com/publications.html): Full, searchable list of papers.
- [Group](https://talkingtorobots.com/CLAW/): Current students, postdocs, and alumni.
- [Yonatan Bisk](https://talkingtorobots.com/yonatanbisk.html): PI homepage, bio, and contact FAQ.
- [Teaching](https://talkingtorobots.com/teaching.html): Courses taught at CMU.
- [Resources](https://talkingtorobots.com/resources.html): Benchmarks and code released by the lab.
- [Grad School FAQ](https://talkingtorobots.com/FAQ.html): Advice for prospective students.

## Recent Publications

- [Position: Anthropomorphic Language in AI Discourse Can Be Constructive](https://talkingtorobots.com/publications.html): NeurIPS 2026 Position Paper Track (2026)
- [ECHO: Embodied Camera Observations of Human Object Carrying](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10438): ArXiv (2026)
- [EmbodiedMidtrain: Bridging the Gap between Vision-Language Models and Vision-Language-Action Models via Mid-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.20012): ArXiv (2026)
- [Data Augmentation for Improving Contextual Faithfulness Under Knowledge Conflict](https://openreview.net/forum?id=61HAlyC5Iy): Findings of The 5th Asia-Pacific Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics {\&} the 15th International Joint Conference on Natural Language Processing (2026)
- [Contextual Observer Grounding: Evaluating Situated Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06880): Findings of The 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (2026)
- [Amplified Does Not Mean Predictive: Reasoning Behaviors in Thinking Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.13760): Third Conference on Language Modeling (2026)
- [Inductive Generalization for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20999): ArXiv (2026)
- [Lost in Reconstruction: Aligning Action Representations with Language in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.10484): ArXiv (2026)
- [Flatness Preserves Instruction Following in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23641): ArXiv (2026)
- [ELASTIC: Efficiently Learning to Adaptively Scale Test-Time Compute for Generative Control Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.31132): ArXiv (2026)
